notes: Simplified (sadeleştirilmiş) Elmalılı, not the original wording (original = MEAL-ELMALILI). tanzil labels it "Elmalılı Hamdi Yazır" (tr.yazir) without saying it is simplified. fawaz "tur-diyanetisleri1" (label "Diyanet Isleri") is this same text (~98%): a misattribution. fawaz "tur-elmallsadelesti1" is a variant of it (~79%). 50 merged verse groups stored once as a..a_end.
